player_prompt.intro: Wo redi PegJump. Fa nnade baako si ɔfoforo so na yi nea woato no fi hɔ kɔ abura a hwee nni mu mu. Botae: wie bere a aka mmɛnkoro pɛ. Akwankyerɛ kwan ne sɛ, '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntwerɔne a enni mu. Fa [i->j] di dwuma.

outcome.win: Wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe a na aka nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biako!
outcome.no_moves: Biribiara nni hɔ a yebetumi ayɛ.
